title: Siquijor Island Marathon 2026 Review: The Philippines' Mystical-Island 42K
seo_title: Siquijor Island Marathon 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: The Siquijor Island Marathon 2026: September 26 on Siquijor. 42K, 21K, 10K, 5K — a full marathon on the Philippines' most mystical island.
dek: Set for 26 September 2026 on Siquijor — the Philippines' 'Island of Fire' known for its folk-healing traditions — this full marathon offers four distances. A marathon on one of the country's most atmospheric islands.
verdict: The Siquijor Island Marathon brings a full 42.195km to one of the Philippines' most distinctive islands — Siquijor, the 'Island of Fire,' known for its folk-healing traditions, pristine beaches, and mystical reputation. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K). Siquijor is a small, circular island with a coastal ring road — expect a scenic, flat-to-rolling course with ocean views for most of the route. September is the tail of the wet season in the Visayas. For runners wanting a Philippine island marathon with genuine atmosphere and off-the-beaten-path appeal, this is a unique pick.

sections.heading: Siquijor: The Mystical Island
paragraphs: Siquijor is one of the Philippines' smallest provinces — a circular island in the Visayas known for its white-sand beaches, waterfalls, and folk-healing traditions. [1] A road marathon on a small island means a coastal ring-road course with ocean views and a uniquely intimate race atmosphere. September is warm and humid.
